source: ui/apps/dashboard/src/widgets/*.tsx (WIDGET_KINDS in registry.ts); kept by hand, in catalogue order

bindings.signal: a signal address on this rig, e.g. blender.flows.dry
bindings.controller: a controller's name: the address of the signal it drives

kinds.label: Readout
kinds.description: One signal: its value, unit, position in range and a sparkline.

sparkline.title: Sparkline
sparkline.description: A small trace under the value; off, the tile is a number only.

kinds.label: Gauge
kinds.description: One signal as a picture: a dial, bar, thermometer or tank with its warn and alarm zones.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: By unit: temperatures a thermometer, percentages a tank, else a dial.

kinds.label: Chart
kinds.description: Signals over time on one axis; a signal in another unit gets its own axis on the right.

window_s.title: Window
window_s.description: Seconds of history shown; 0 follows the page setting.

every.title: Sample
every.description: Draw one point in n; 0 follows the page setting.

y.title: Y axis
y.description: page: the page setting; auto: fit the data; range: the signal's declared range.

kinds.label: Controller
kinds.description: A controller's faceplate: reading, target and output rows, with the Process/Drive trends beside them.

view.title: View
view.description: compact: reading/target/output rows only; full: rows and the Process/Drive trends.

kinds.label: Device
kinds.description: A device's state, conditions and run, with a form per command; pick which commands, or show them all.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Command names of that device; empty shows every command.

kinds.label: Program
kinds.description: What the programmer is running: the program, its step, progress, and the last few program events.

events.title: Recent events
events.description: How many program events to list under the status; 0 for none.

kinds.label: Recording
kinds.description: The open session, and buttons to start or end one.

controls.title: Start/end buttons
controls.description: Off, the tile only says whether a session is open.

kinds.label: Events
kinds.description: The rig's latest events, newest first, from a level up; optionally one scope only.

limit.title: Rows
limit.description: At most; the widget shows as many as its height holds.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Only this scope (`program`, `controller`, `device`, ...); blank for all.

kinds.label: Health
kinds.description: The rig's condition at a glance: fault or ok, recording, devices polling, controllers, conditions, waits, uptime.

tiles.title: Tiles
tiles.description: Which stats, in this order; none ticked shows the first five.

kinds.label: Text
kinds.description: A note: markdown (headings, lists, bold, links) or plain text.

kinds.label: Heading
kinds.description: A section title across the grid, to group the tiles under it.

kinds.label: Spacer
kinds.description: Empty room, to push tiles apart or start a new row.

kinds.label: Link
kinds.description: A button to a page of the app -- a device, a signal, a controller, a program -- or to a URL.

name.title: Name
name.description: The thing on that page (a device or program name, a signal's or controller's address, a session id); blank for the list.
